entry_state: The bank chapter closes with separate accounting,regulatory and behavioural assumptions. A short-coverage cohort reconciles gross and ceded balances separately;the actuarial triangle gives a point estimate148 while leaving unsupported tail uncertainty unavailable. exit_state: General measurement separates future coverage,incurred claims,risk adjustment and unearned profit. The connected profitable group,onerous group and treaty reconcile at intermediate dates as well as terminal cash. Loss and recovery components sit within their measured balances. Atomic publication now requires the complete declared group set,valid component calculations and matching journals;replay details continue next.
findings: The zero-rate case stages the loss-component ordering before adding finance. It explicitly distinguishes future-service revisions from incurred-claim expense.
The nonzero-rate example reconciles total revenue137.05 less finance17.05 to premium120 without equating each year's revenue with cash receipts.
The connected groups retain separate profitability and treaty-recognition timing. Incorrect pooling and late treaty recognition can share terminal cash88.3 while changing intermediate equity.
The loss-component financing rule is a declared proportional allocation for unchanged facts;its recovery component is not an extra asset. No new confirmed local defect.
